title: cloudflare-sandbox collect merges an attempt whose only commit is the worker's report
body: collect.go classifies no-commits with rev-list --count base..head, but image/worker.sh commit_report always commits RESULT-<tick>.md as its own commit, so an implement-tick worker that changed nothing and wrote STATUS: DONE collects as ready_to_merge, and every cloud attempt merges RESULT-<tick>.md into the epic branch root. collect_test.go's fake puts work and report in one commit, which the real worker never does.
